text:
incident-bot: Pager: KV continuous-batching anomaly on cluster rwd-nyc-3. spike in kv writes / evictions, p90 latency -> 800ms, p99 -> 5s, errors up ~3.8%. Alert threshold breached: kv_evictions > 5k/min. https://dashboards/redwood/alerts/2325006789
Priya G.: I'm paged, looking now.
Ethan K.: seeing a sudden rise in unique prefix keys per logical shard. MQA traffic to qwen-1.3-mqa has very high prefix cardinality; continuous batching seems to be merging many tiny prefixes into huge batches -> blowout of KV write amplification.
Priya G.: Which model variants? I see traffic heavy to qwen-1.3-mqa (prod) and a smaller spike to mistral-7b-prefetch. Qwen MQA path is the biggest contributor.
Matt P.: On it. Preparing hotfix to disable continuous batching for qwen-1.3-mqa on prod shard group A (rwd-nyc-3, rwd-sfo-1).
deploy-bot: Starting rollout: rwdctl rollout update --model qwen-1.3-mqa --continuous_batching=false --scope shardgroup=A
Matt P.: Hotfix deployed to shardgroup A, rolling to B next. Monitoring KV evictions and batch sizes.
Priya G.: KV cache size dropping back towards baseline, eviction rate down ~70%, p99 improving to ~1s and trending down. Logs: ```kv_evictions: 4800 -> 1200; batch_size_avg: 340 -> 45```
Luis R.: Customer impact: 3 paid customers saw elevated errors in last 7m, one Enterprise Dedicated tenant saw brief 503s (~2m). CS ticket CS-4789 opened, account notified.
Sarah M.: We should also harden configs: temporarily set batch_max_keys=2000, batch_token_limit=2048 and cache_eviction_threshold=0.85 to avoid batch-catapult next time. Propose also adding a safety cap on continuous batching per-model.
Ethan K.: Agree. I'll open PR with those defaults + a canary rollout. PR will also include telemetry to break out per-prefix cardinality.
Priya G.: Also saw Llama variant increasing retries; suggest adding a model-tier fallback policy. If qwen MQA contbatch disabled and latency still >1.2s, route traffic to llama-2-13b-v2 fallback (lower throughput but stable).
oncall-bot: Handoff: @Sarah M. you're oncall next. Notes: contbatch disabled for qwen-1.3-mqa, watch kv hit ratio and p99.
Sarah M.: Ack. I'll watch dashboards and raise temporary alert: p99>1.2s OR kv_evictions>10k/min. Will coordinate with CS for customer comms.
Matt P.: Follow-up config change applied: increased small-prefix cache TTL and tightened kv write batching thresholds. Added transparent fallback policy for enterprise tenants.
deploy-bot: Hotfix persisted; rollback not required.
Priya G.: Summary for postmortem: root cause appears to be MQA workload with extreme prefix cardinality combined with continuous-batching merging many small prefixes into oversized batches that amplify KV cache writes and cause eviction thrash. Immediate mitigations: disabled continuous batching for qwen-1.3-mqa, applied batch caps, increased eviction threshold, enabled model fallback. Next steps: quantify customer impact, load-test MQA patterns, update default batching policy, add per-model contbatch safety caps.
Ethan K.: I'll own the postmortem draft and perf-run. ETA 2 hours for initial writeup with numbers and proposed config changes.
Luis R.: Noted customer impact in CS-4789 and informed account teams; tracking compensation risk for the Enterprise tenant.
Sarah M.: Thanks team. If no regressions in 30m we'll mark pager resolved and follow-up in INC-232500. Leaving timeline and commands in the incident ticket.
Matt P.: Leaving a short runbook patch in ops playbook: "If MQA kv spike detected -> disable contbatch for MQA variant -> apply batch caps -> escalate to SRE/ML infra if evictions persist."
Priya G.: Closing loop on console alerts and adding a transient dashboard for prefix-cardinality heatmap.
Ethan K.: Added TODO: simulate mixed GQA/MQA traffic in perf lab; specifically test qwen-1.3-mqa and mistral-7b-prefetch combinations that previously triggered catapult.
Sarah M.: Acknowledged. Handing off to follow-up owners.
